review_description: It is a minefield with a lot of variables, the movement in the STC was one area that greater explanation should happen. They went down from $38.00 to $33.00 in one hit from the time quoted till the time ordered, (a couple of days), did verify, and was true and correct, however not explained at the time of quote.I chose a 6.3W AC suntech system with enphase inverters, 20 panels, with 10 easterly and 10 westerly aspect.Waiting on results, as the proof will be in the pudding in the next billing quarter.Your website and service was very reassurring that we were venturing down the correct path.Thanks and regardsJim
